name: coreforge-trading-mcp

tools.name: trading_signal
tools.description: Deterministic strategy-state computation for one symbol: the current state of five published rule sets (ma_crossover, rsi_mean_reversion, momentum, leveraged_momentum, macd_crossover) plus an ensemble state over daily bars; BTC/ETH/SOL also carry a Coinversa sentiment block. Computed data, not a recommendation. Paid via x402 ($0.02 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

symbol.description: Symbol, e.g. SPY, AAPL, BTC, ETH, SOL (16 equities/ETFs + BTC/ETH/SOL in the core universe)

strategy.description: Return only this one strategy's state

tools.name: trading_signals_board
tools.description: Full-universe strategy-state snapshot: all 16 equities/ETFs plus BTC, ETH and SOL, each with the five rule-set states and an ensemble state. Computed data, not a recommendation. Paid via x402 ($0.05 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

tools.name: trading_regime
tools.description: Market-regime classification (9 states) computed from universe breadth, trend and volatility, with the per-regime strategy-weight table and a summary. Computed data, not a recommendation. Paid via x402 ($0.05 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

tools.name: trading_backtest
tools.description: Historical rule-set evaluation over daily bars: net return, win rate, max drawdown and trade count for the latest window (in-sample) and the window before it (out-of-sample walk-forward); optional Monte Carlo block-resample distribution. Computed data, not a performance promise. Paid via x402 ($0.05 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

monteCarlo.description: Add the Monte Carlo distribution (500 simulations)

tools.name: trading_indicators
tools.description: Technical-indicator computation (SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, plus the ensemble state) on bars you supply — no external data fetch. Computed data, not a recommendation. Paid via x402 ($0.01 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

date.description: Bar date (any label; defaults to the bar index)

bars.description: OHLCV bars (10–5000); each needs at least a close

series.description: Also return the full indicator series, not just the latest values

tools.name: portfolio_risk
tools.description: Portfolio risk computation: per-holding and portfolio volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown, VaR/CVaR, correlation and concentration analysis; optional predefined-scenario stress tests and Monte Carlo distribution. Bars are fetched per symbol unless you supply closes/bars per holding. Computed data, not a recommendation. Paid via x402 ($0.05 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

weight.description: Portfolio weight (alternative to dollarValue; pair with totalValue)

closes.description: Supply closes instead of fetching bars

date.description: Bar date (any label; defaults to the bar index)

holdings.description: 2–20 holdings, each with dollarValue or weight

tools.name: options_greeks
tools.description: Black-Scholes model computation (no live quotes): either a generated option chain for an expiry, or multi-leg payoff analysis (max loss/profit, breakevens, net premium) with per-leg Greeks. Model values from inputs, not a recommendation. Paid via x402 ($0.02 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

expiryDate.description: Chain expiry, YYYY-MM-DD (chain mode; or use expiryDays)

strikes.description: Chain strikes (default: 9 strikes around the underlying)

legs.description: Legs mode: 1–8 option legs to analyse as one strategy

tools.name: catalyst_classify
tools.description: Classify headlines into market-catalyst categories (earnings, merger/acquisition, buyback, dividend, guidance, restructuring, regulatory, legal, news), shaped as events with any tickers you attach. Classification only — no direction or outcome prediction. Paid via x402 ($0.01 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

headlines.description: Up to 50 headlines, as strings or {headline, tickers} objects

tools.name: gov_contracts
tools.description: Recent US federal contract awards (contract types A–D) from the public USAspending.gov API, deduplicated and largest-first, with recipient names resolved to tickers where a confident match exists. Public data, repackaged. Paid via x402 ($0.02 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

ticker.description: Only awards resolved to this ticker

tools.name: token_analytics
tools.description: Token market-data bundle from public DEX data: price, FDV/market cap, liquidity, volume windows, 24h transactions, pair list and market age. Raw data — no scores or opinions. Paid via x402 ($0.05 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

address.description: Token address: an EVM 0x… contract address or a Solana mint address

tools.name: chain_balance
tools.description: Base chain read: native ETH balance of an address. Paid via x402 ($0.002 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

tools.name: chain_token_balance
tools.description: Base chain read: ERC-20 token balance of an address, with the token's symbol and decimals resolved on-chain. Paid via x402 ($0.003 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

tools.name: chain_block
tools.description: Base chain read: latest block number, hash, timestamp and transaction count. Paid via x402 ($0.001 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

tools.name: chain_gas
tools.description: Base chain read: current gas price (wei and gwei). Paid via x402 ($0.001 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.
